messages:
maria (DevEx): Heads-up: onboarding sample app fails with 403 after rotating API key. Repro below.
sam (Eng): oh no — which key, org or project scoped?
maria (DevEx): project-scoped. we set REDWOOD_PROJECT=acme and rotated REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, but app seems to keep sending org key and gets 403
devon (SDK): @maria can you paste the env and the exact error? also which sdk version?
maria (DevEx): sdk-js v0.9.2. Env dump: 
```
REDWOOD_PROJECT=acme
REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_new
REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_old
```
After rotation we updated REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY but left REDWOOD_API_KEY (org_old) in the container image; requests go out with org_old -> 403
devon (SDK): hmmm. SDK is supposed to prefer a project key when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set. @sam can you confirm whether the batching layer rewrites auth header?
sam (Eng): checking request logs... Authorization header on outgoing requests is `Bearer org_old`. dug into auth.ts — env precedence currently coded as API_KEY > PROJECT_KEY > CLI_TOKEN. that's backwards for project-scoped flows
devon (SDK): yikes. that's the bug. expected precedence: if REDWOOD_PROJECT is set then PROJECT_KEY > API_KEY, otherwise API_KEY acts as org-level fallback. i'll open a quick PR to flip precedence and add unit tests
jen (PM): we should also surface a one-time warning or onboarding hint when both keys exist. docs currently ambiguous and this will keep biting new users :/
maria (DevEx): :thumbsup: also proposing a `redwood doctor` check that warns when REDWOOD_API_KEY is present alongside REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY to avoid accidental fallbacks during rotation
devon (SDK): agreed. i'll add a console.warn in the SDK (one-time per process) + a CLI diagnostic lint. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/1234 (draft)
ops-lisa: from infra side, can we make server errors clearer? right now we return 403 for scope mismatch which looks like permission denied — it would help to return 401 or 403 with a structured body like {code: "auth_scope_mismatch", detail: "token not valid for project acme"}
sam (Eng): yes clearer error + maybe an `x-request-scope` response header would let clients detect and surface more actionable messages in onboarding UIs
devon (SDK): good call. also changing retry semantics: do NOT auto-retry on 403 from an auth mismatch. only retry on 429/5xx. prevents credential thrash during rotations
maria (DevEx): dropping repro logs and a tiny script in a gist: https://gist.github.com/anon/rotation-repro — will smoke test when PR lands
ci-bot: ci: running test matrix for branch swap-auth-precedence... all tests pass (12/12)
devon (SDK): merged and cut release v0.9.3. changelog: "Fix env var precedence bug causing SDK to prefer org key over project key when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set; warn when both keys present; adjust retry semantics for auth failures."
maria (DevEx): verified in sample app + onboarding playbook. rotation flow is smooth now. thanks y'all, closing this thread
